name: db export
description: A receipt: the files written (-j needs -o; the export itself never shares stdout with the document) and their counts.

name: db seed
description: Sample rows written per table; a row already present is skipped and not counted.

name: dns
description: One answer per name: every record type asked for, each record with its TTL, and how many answers were stored.

name: endpoints
description: Endpoints (origin + path template) aggregated from stored traffic.

name: export
description: A receipt: the files written (-j needs -o; the export itself never shares stdout with the document) and their counts.

name: extensions eval
description: The code's return value as JSON (null for undefined), as `js -j`. With --record-uuid the document is `extensions run`'s.

name: extensions example
description: Copy-pasteable example extensions; code is omitted under --list.

name: extensions lint
description: One item per linted file with its issues (severity, line, col, message, rule); summary counts them. ok is false exactly when there are errors (exit 1, lint_failed).

name: extensions preset
description: Every preset file considered (installed, skipped, failed) plus vigolium.d.ts (updated or current).

name: extensions run
description: What one extension reported for one stored record (ext run, ext eval --record-uuid): items are its results; errors are the handler calls that threw; network_calls_blocked counts the requests an offline run refused. ok is false when a handler threw (exit 1).

name: extensions test
description: One item per fixture case (or per extension that ran none: skipped with a reason, or failed to load); passed/failed/skipped count them. ok is false when any case failed (exit 1).

name: extensions types
description: vigolium.d.ts: the file written with -o, or the declarations inline as content.

name: finding
description: Stored findings as finding views; --curl rows render each finding's request as a curl command.

name: finding mark
description: Findings whose status changed; unchanged and not_found list the rest.

name: fingerprint
description: The scan document of a fingerprint run whose items are the origins it fingerprinted (the `hosts` view).

name: fuzz
description: The run summary: items are the top-ranked matched results (total is every match); --fields projects them.

name: hosts
description: Stored host facts per host:port: DNS, TLS certificate, fingerprint report and not-found baseline, with the survey facts lifted to the top.

name: import
description: items is always []; the import counters stay at the top level (a parse, a SQLite merge, or a live bridge import).

name: ingest
description: The records the ingest left in the store (capped; items_truncated says more exist), with why any were not stored.

name: js
description: The script's return value as JSON (null for undefined).

name: log
description: `log <uuid> -j`: the session log's lines (the --tail/--full window) with its identity and liveness.

name: log ls
description: Native and agentic scan sessions with liveness (effective_status, stale, last_write_at); --reap adds reaped and status_files_removed.

name: module disable
description: Every module the search matched, each saying whether this run flipped it.

name: module enable
description: Every module the search matched, each saying whether this run flipped it.

name: oast ingest
description: Findings saved from logged OAST callbacks; the counters say how the callbacks were attributed.

name: params
description: Parameters by endpoint and location, aggregated from stored traffic.

name: project create
description: The project created.

name: project delete
description: The project deleted, with what it held.

name: project use
description: The project activated (or created with --create).

name: replay
description: One row per replayed record: the baseline, the replay and their diff. A single source is one item; a bulk run counts failed rows.

name: run
description: The scan document: one document per invocation, items are finding views.

name: scan
description: The scan document: one document per invocation, items are finding views.

name: scan diff
description: Findings classified new / unchanged / fixed / not_reobserved between two scans.

name: scan status
description: One scan's live status: phase, progress, liveness, ETA and the stored plan.

name: scan wait
description: The finished scan's scan document (the one scan -j prints, rebuilt from the stored row), printed once the scan ends.

name: scan-request
description: The scan document: one document per invocation, items are finding views.

name: scan-url
description: The scan document: one document per invocation, items are finding views.

name: schema flags
description: One command's flags (for_command): name, shorthand, type, default, description, inherited.

name: schema storage
description: The database's tables with columns, row counts, purpose, and the -j field a column surfaces as.

name: traffic
description: Stored HTTP records; --curl rows render each request as a curl command.

name: traffic body
description: A receipt for one extracted body: size, sha256, completeness and where it was written.

name: traffic headers
description: One stored message's headers as an ordered array (repeated headers kept).

name: scan.started
description: First line of every stream: what the scan will run, against what, at what pace and budget.

name: scan.interrupting
description: A shutdown signal arrived and the graceful stop began. Nonterminal: scan.finished still follows.

name: scan.finished
description: The terminal line, on every reachable exit path. status: completed, curtailed, interrupted or failed.

name: phase.started
description: A phase began.

name: phase.progress
description: Heartbeat while a phase runs. total is a non-decreasing upper bound, absent until known.

name: phase.finished
description: A phase ended. status: completed, curtailed or failed; reasons are defects, limits configured bounds reached.

name: waf.block
description: The edge started filtering scan traffic for a host.

name: waf.pacing
description: Proactive pacing armed for a host behind a CDN/WAF edge.

name: finding.new
description: A finding was reported. Metadata only: the evidence is in the database.

name: import.summary
description: What a bridge import is about to write: total will cross, matched is what the source holds.

name: error
description: A NON-fatal error. A failure that ends the run is scan.finished{status:failed}.

name: scan.plan
description: The resolved scan plan, second on every stream (the same object `scan --dry-run` prints).

name: scan.setup
description: A lazy first-run install inside the phase that needs it, before that phase's clock starts: component chrome|nuclei (the `doctor --fix --only` id), state started|finished|failed. bytes is the download size when known; duration_ms and message (failed) ride on the terminal line.

name: oast.unavailable
description: OAST registration failed or timed out: out-of-band checks do not run (scan partial, oast_unavailable).

name: host.quarantined
description: A host's breaker opened after consecutive errors; it is re-probed after a cooldown.

name: host.recovered
description: A quarantined host answered its probe and is back in rotation.

name: host.dead
description: A host failed every probe: no further requests go to it this scan.

name: auth.session_suspect
description: Responses for a session look logged out; gen is the suspected credential generation.

name: auth.relogin
description: How a re-login cycle ended: ok, the new generation when it worked, count of logins tried.

name: module.error
description: A module call failed (error_kind exception, timeout or panic). Rate-limited per module: the first 3, then every 100th; count is the module's running error total for the scan.

name: extension.failed
description: An extension failed to load: stage is the load step that failed; explicit says it was named with --ext (the scan then stops, exit 2 extension_load_failed, unless --ext-allow-failures).

name: error
description: The -j error envelope (ok:false).

name: plan
description: The resolved scan plan: phases with disabled_by, budgets, modules, scope, auth names, target admission and a rough request estimate. Printed by scan --dry-run, carried by the scan.plan event, stored on scans.plan.

name: scan-dry-run
description: The scan --dry-run / run <phase> --dry-run -j document: items are the plan's phases, plan the full plan, dry_run true.
